name: Open Close
summary: This EA trades based on the relationship between the current bar's open and close prices, entering positions when the open and close price difference meets a specified threshold. It is a simple price-action scalping strategy that operates on lower timeframes, opening trades in the direction of the candle body magnitude.
summary_zh: 该EA基于当前K线开盘价与收盘价的关系进行交易，当开收盘价差达到指定阈值时进场。这是一个简单的价格行为剥头皮策略，在低周期运行，根据K线实体大小方向开仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于K线开盘价与收盘价的差值作为入场信号，当差值超过设定阈值时认为存在方向性动量。入场条件为当前K线的开收盘价差超过指定参数值，差值为正则做多，差值为负则做空。出场条件依赖止盈和止损参数，没有复杂的跟踪止损或移动止盈机制。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，没有根据账户余额或波动率动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏风险百分比计算，仅依赖用户手动设置合理手数。该策略逻辑极其简单，没有考虑市场结构、趋势过滤或多时间框架确认。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the difference between a candle's open and close prices as an entry signal, assuming directional momentum exists when the body exceeds a threshold. Entry conditions trigger when the current bar's open-close difference surpasses a specified parameter value - positive difference for buy, negative for sell. Exit conditions rely solely on fixed take-profit and stop-loss parameters, with no trailing stop or dynamic exit mechanisms. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach without dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management lacks percentage-based risk calculation, depending entirely on the user manually setting reasonable lot sizes. The strategy logic is extremely simplistic, failing to consider market structure, trend filtering, or multi-timeframe confirmation.

parameters.name: Open_Close_Diff
parameters.description_en: Open-close price difference threshold in points

parameters.name: Magic_Number
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于标识订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和修改
基于纯粹价格行为，不依赖滞后指标
参数数量少，优化空间清晰
止损止盈明确，风险可预设
pros_en: Simple and intuitive strategy logic, easy to understand and modify
Based on pure price action without relying on lagging indicators
Few parameters with clear optimization space
Defined stop-loss and take-profit for preset risk management
cons: 没有趋势过滤器，可能在震荡市中频繁亏损
缺乏多时间框架确认，信号可靠性低
固定手数无法根据账户风险动态调整
没有点差过滤，在低周期剥头皮时可能被高点差吞噬利润
没有新K线检查，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: No trend filter, likely to suffer frequent losses in ranging markets
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation, resulting in low signal reliability
Fixed lot sizing cannot dynamically adjust based on account risk
No spread filter, high spreads on lower timeframes can erode scalping profits
No new bar check, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 增加趋势过滤器(如均线方向)避免逆势交易
添加多时间框架确认提高信号质量
实现基于账户余额的动态仓位管理
增加点差过滤和新K线检查
improvements_en: Add a trend filter (e.g., moving average direction) to avoid counter-trend trades
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation to improve signal quality
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account equity percentage
Add spread filter and new bar check to prevent unfavorable entries

risk_points: 没有新K线检查可能导致同一K线重复开仓造成过度暴露
没有点差过滤在剥头皮策略中极易因滑点和点差亏损
固定手数缺乏资金管理，用户可能设置过大手数导致爆仓
risk_points_en: No new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same bar leading to overexposure
No spread filter in a scalping strategy makes it vulnerable to losses from slippage and wide spreads
Fixed lot sizing without money management allows users to set excessive lots risking account blowup
